_note:
Controls what the Intelligence Layer mines every Tuesday. Match subreddits and 
keywords to your actual ICP — not generic marketing communities.

reddit._subreddits_note: Copy from product-dna.json icp.subreddits. Without r/ prefix.
reddit._sorts_note:
'rising' catches emerging conversations before they peak. Always include it 
alongside 'hot'.
reddit._intent_note:
Posts scoring below this on the buying intent algorithm are excluded. 
Lower = more results, lower quality.
reddit._urgency_note: Posts below this urgency score are excluded.
reddit._score_note:
Minimum Reddit score (upvotes - downvotes). Filters out very 
low-engagement posts.

hackernews._keywords_note:
HN stories are filtered by these keywords for relevance to your 
product category.

competitors.name: COMPETITOR_A
competitors._note:
GitHub Issues on this repo are mined weekly for failure patterns that become 
your copy angles.

_pain_note:
Extra keywords that supplement the scoring algorithm. Add product-specific 
pain language from your subreddits.
_buying_note: Strong buying intent signals that boost a post's score when found.
competitor_repos._instructions: GitHub owner/repo paths. competitor-autopsist mines their Issues for failure patterns. e.g. 'someorg/someproduct'
competitor_repos.PLACEHOLDER_ORG/PLACEHOLDER_REPO: Replace with real competitor GitHub repos
seo_keywords._instructions: Primary SEO keywords for AEO blog post optimization and citation-tracker.js. Think: what does your ICP type into Google?
hn_keywords._instructions: Keywords for Hacker News mining. Also duplicated from hackernews.relevance_keywords for direct agent access.
